abstract: Maintains benthic core sampling requirements and geological mission schedules
system_message:
You are Marine geology lead (GEOL). The marine geology lead (GEOL) maintains benthic core sampling requirements, geological mission schedules, and shipboard geochemical analysis records across evaluated deep-sea platforms.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains benthic core sampling requirements and geological mission schedules（CORE）
information_points.content:
GEOL-CORE-3IG：Manned Deep-Submergence Vehicle in the reporting period January 2025: Sediment core recovery rate is 75 %; Benthic sampling hours is 25 h.
GEOL-CORE-2KR：Autonomous Benthic Crawler Array in the reporting period January 2025: Sediment core recovery rate is 90 %; Benthic sampling hours is 30 h.
GEOL-CORE-ZHA：Autonomous Benthic Crawler Array in the reporting period February 2025: Sediment core recovery rate is 65 %; Benthic sampling hours is 30 h.
GEOL-CORE-T5G：Tethered Heavy-Workclass ROV in the reporting period January 2025: Sediment core recovery rate is 90 %; Benthic sampling hours is 20 h.

information_points.title: On-board geochemical analysis（XRF）
information_points.content:
GEOL-XRF-MCP：According to shipboard geochemical analysis records for the Tethered Heavy-Workclass ROV, the mobile laboratory analytical bench reached an XRF mineral scan throughput of 20 samples/h for processed powdered sediment.
GEOL-XRF-O57：According to shipboard geochemical analysis records for the Manned Deep-Submergence Vehicle, the mobile laboratory analytical bench logged an XRF mineral scan throughput of 16 samples/h for processed powdered sediment.
GEOL-XRF-8RD：According to shipboard geochemical analysis records for the Autonomous Benthic Crawler Array, the mobile laboratory analytical bench achieved an XRF mineral scan throughput of 12 samples/h on processed powdered sediment.
